# Resident's restricted amalgamation: acquisition of trading stock ¶20-107

Where property transferred on a resident's restricted amalgamation is trading stock of both the amalgamating and amalgamated companies, the consideration for the disposal and acquisition is taken as the value of the trading stock to the amalgamating company as determined under the valuation methods provided for in subpart EB. Valuation of the trading stock will be at the time of the amalgamation. See s FO 10(5).

For further background on the available valuation methods, see ¶9-020–¶9-063.

*Refs: s FO 10(5)*
